title: Active Directory Password Reset Guide
problem: Employee cannot access their account because the password is forgotten, expired, or the account is locked.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Employee Identity
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Confirm the employee identity using the approved verification process before performing any password-related action.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Identity Verification

troubleshooting_steps.title: Open Active Directory Users and Computers
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Launch Active Directory Users and Computers from the administrative workstation.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Active Directory Console

troubleshooting_steps.title: Search Employee Account
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Locate the employee account using Employee ID or username.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Search User

troubleshooting_steps.title: Reset Password
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Right-click the account and select Reset Password. Enter the temporary password according to company policy.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Reset Password Dialog

troubleshooting_steps.title: Require Password Change
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Enable 'User must change password at next logon' unless the support policy specifies otherwise.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Password Options

escalation.condition: Escalate if the account remains inaccessible after password reset or Active Directory reports additional errors.

screenshots.caption: Open Active Directory Users and Computers

faq.question: What if the employee forgot the username?
faq.answer: Search using the Employee ID or official employee records.

faq.question: What if the account is still locked?
faq.answer: Escalate the issue to the Identity and Access Management team.
